*   Topic: Why the sky is blue during the day and what color it changes to at sunset.
*   Format: Exactly two paragraphs.
*   Language: Spanish.
*   Constraint: No lists (sin listas).

    *   *Daytime:* Rayleigh scattering. Sunlight (white light) hits the atmosphere. Shorter wavelengths (blue/violet) scatter more easily off gas molecules and particles. Our eyes are more sensitive to blue than violet.
    *   *Sunset:* The sun is lower on the horizon. Light travels a longer path through the atmosphere. Most of the blue/violet light is scattered away before reaching our eyes. The longer wavelengths (red/orange/yellow) remain and reach us.
